feature: Email template branding audit — 27 DB email_templates slugs: DB-row-used + wrapped in branded-layout {{body}} (Epic #803, screenshot-gated per #975)
notes: PURPOSE: verify, per #976, that each of the 27 real email_templates slugs (a) is actually sent from the DB row rather than a hardcoded mailer.ts body, and (b) is wrapped in the branded-layout {{body}} substitution before it goes out. branded-layout (the wrapper) and tenant-health-block (an embedded snippet) are exempt from the top-level wrap check by design.

SEND-PATH MODEL (traced against this commit): every sendEmailFromTemplate(slug,...) reads the DB row (getEmailTemplateOrFallback) then sends via sendEmail(...) with NO skipWrapper, so it is auto-wrapped in branded-layout. The workflow 'send_email' node (workflow-executor.ts, actionType==='send_email') with a templateSlug does the same via getEmailTemplateOrFallback + sendEmailOrThrow/sendEmailForMspOrThrow (also auto-wrapped). The two PDF-attachment paths (quiz-report-email, service-overview-email) use sendEmailWithAttachment, which does NOT auto-wrap, and correctly compensate by calling `await brandedEmail(bodyHtml)` explicitly before the send.

PER-TEMPLATE CLASSIFICATION — full write-up in test-manifests/mailer/README.md. Summary: 20 = DB-used-and-correctly-wrapped; 1 = still-calling-old-hardcoded-function (purchase-confirmation); 4 = no-real-trigger-path-found (client-thread-reply, kanban-script-exhausted, kanban-document-exhausted, manual-script-escalation); 2 = wrapper/snippet exempt (branded-layout, tenant-health-block); 0 = DB-used-but-NOT-wrapped.

KEY FINDING (drift #976 was hunting): purchase-confirmation — public-assessment-payment.ts:865 calls sendEmail(order.email, 'Payment confirmed — …', purchaseConfirmationEmail({…}), { templateName: 'purchase-confirmation-home-flow' }). This invokes the HARDCODED purchaseConfirmationEmail() body builder and NEVER reads the purchase-confirmation DB row (the templateName arg is only a failed_notifications label, not a slug lookup). It is still branded (sendEmail wraps in branded-layout), but Admin-Panel edits to the purchase-confirmation row have zero effect on what actually goes out. The apiTest below asserts the DB row's content so drift can be diffed against production copy; the #976 report does NOT fix it (audit-only) — flagged for Shane.

SCREENSHOT GATE: the uiSteps drive the Admin Panel Email Templates page (/content/email-templates). Its Preview pane fetches the real DB row AND the real branded-layout row and renders wrapperHtml.replace('{{body}}', bodyHtml) into a sandboxed iframe — i.e. the exact composed+wrapped email, straight from the DB. Per #977 every uiStep captures a screenshot; per #975 the first run seeds a baseline (Shane approves) and later runs only interrupt on visual drift. This is Shane's explicit 'screenshot-gated, not pass/fail on send success' requirement.

PRECONDITIONS (BuildConsole #953 Test Environment Variables store): {{TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL}}/{{TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD}} must be a PlatformAdmin account (email-templates routes are requireAdmin). {{DEPLOY_URL}} is the Admin Panel origin. The apiTest login extracts {{adminToken}} for the requireAdmin GETs.

HONESTY / LIMITS: (1) not run here — no BuildConsole/WebView2/DB/mail access in this Claude Code session; selectors are real (data-testids added to EmailTemplates.tsx this commit) but the run itself is Shane's. (2) The 3 kanban/manual slugs + client-thread-reply are DB rows with no wired send; they still render in the Admin preview (they have DB content), so their screenshots prove the row content, not a live send. (3) welcome-email is only reachable via a DB-configured workflow send_email node — its screenshot proves the row + wrapping, but whether a live workflow fires it is a DB-config question (see the read-only diagnostic SQL for Shane: lib/db/migrations/manual/archive/diagnostics/2026-08-13-email-template-audit-976.sql). (4) uiStep expect is state-only — assertions are on element visibility, not DOM text; response-body content is asserted in apiTests via #892 containsAny/containsNone.

apiTests.name: log in as the PlatformAdmin test account — email_templates admin routes are requireAdmin
GET the full template list — confirms the real DB rows are served to the Admin Panel list the uiSteps click through
branded-layout (WRAPPER) — MUST retain the {{body}} placeholder; this is the substitution point every wrapped send fills. If this token were missing, nothing would wrap.

purchase-confirmation — DB row content assertion. The row is inner HTML only (no <!DOCTYPE/<html>), so it is designed to be wrapped by branded-layout. NOTE: the live home-flow send (public-assessment-payment.ts:865) bypasses this row and uses the hardcoded purchaseConfirmationEmail() instead — this test captures the DB copy so that drift is diffable.

discovery-call-confirmation — representative correctly-wrapped client template: inner HTML only + embeds the {{tenantHealthBlockHtml}} snippet slot; wrapped in branded-layout at send by sendEmailFromTemplate (booking.ts:268).
tenant-health-block (SNIPPET) — reusable fragment embedded into client templates via {{tenantHealthBlockHtml}}; it is NOT the wrapper, so it must NOT contain the {{body}} slot.

kanban-script-exhausted — orphan-row existence check. The row EXISTS in the DB (part of Shane's 27) but has ZERO code send path (not seeded by seed-email-templates.ts, no sendEmailFromTemplate/getEmailTemplateOrFallback/workflow reference). Confirms the no-trigger finding is about wiring, not a missing row.

client-thread-reply — orphan-row existence check. DB row + hardcoded clientThreadReplyEmail() both exist, but the function is never called and no send path references this slug (only admin-thread-reply fires on status-report threads).
